Implemented the full **Dashboard Structural Alignment Plan** end-to-end (without editing the plan file), and completed all to-dos.

### What I changed

- Reworked the dashboard shell in `app/page.tsx` to match the target structure:
  - Left vertical sidebar
  - Top control bar (`Today/Week/Month/Custom`, region select, search)
  - KPI strip across the top content row
  - Large map panel + right-side stat stack beneath it
- Removed drag/resize/remove card controls from the KPI presentation flow (structural parity focus).
- Updated KPI card styling in `components/metric-card.tsx` to match a light enterprise look:
  - Lighter surfaces/borders
  - Updated trend colors/format
  - Softer inline mini-chart treatment
- Simplified KPI grid behavior in `components/dashboard-grid.tsx` for fixed executive strip layout.
- Added an interactive US map component in `components/region-map.tsx`:
  - Uses `d3-geo` + `topojson-client`
  - Loads US states topology
  - Renders seeded regional hotspot markers
  - Supports hover feedback for city/job volume
- Shifted theme tokens from dark/neon to light/neutral in:
  - `app/globals.css`
  - `tailwind.config.ts`
- Updated `components/add-metric-panel.tsx` styling for visual consistency (even though it’s no longer in the main dashboard flow).

### Dependencies added

- `d3-geo`
- `topojson-client`
- `@types/geojson` (dev)
- `@types/topojson-specification` (dev)

### Verification run

- `npm run lint` ✅
- `npm run typecheck` ✅
- Runtime shell check against local dev server response markers ✅

If you want, next pass I can do the **pixel-close polish** against your image (exact spacing, typography sizes/weights, icon treatment, and finer map visual tuning).
